**Why the admin couldn't find those users:** The role-scope form loaded its user list with one unpaged request, `useUsers({ v: 'default' })`, and no `limit` or `q`. The REST layer returns only its default page of users (I believe 50, but I could not confirm that constant in Falkon). Any account past that first page never reached the client. The `ComboBox` then filtered only that already-fetched list, so a user left off the first response could not be searched for or selected. The old code also hid the whole user field when the first response was empty. The fix is entirely in the frontend.

**What fixed it:** PR #567, "(fix) O3-4518: Stock management ESM: Unable to add user role scope on systems with many users", merged as commit `3c071999`. It replaced the bulk load with server-side search. The form now uses `useSearchUser`, which sends `limit: 10` and a `q` search string, and the search input is debounced by one second. The change follows the pattern already used by `UsersSelector`. The current code carries the comment "Server-side user search (fixes O3-4518: systems with many users)".

**Other notes:**
- The merge commit's subject is "(chore) Update OpenMRS dependencies (#566) (#567)", which does not match the PR title. The diff for that commit is the user-search change.
- An earlier fix for the same symptom, commit `a23eb534` (#133, March 2024), addressed the same "more than the default REST page size" report. It changed the `useUser` URL and removed a `handleUsersSearch` stub, but it did not add server-side search.
- Falkon has no imported PRs for `openmrs-module-stockmanagement` or this app, so PR and ticket links came from the ticket pattern in the PR title and body.
